description.zh: 录像开始时间，格式为10位时间戳，单位为秒。
description.en: The recording start time. The value is a 10-digit UNIX timestamp, in seconds.

description.zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的**设备**页查看**DeviceName**。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**ProductKey**。
></notice>
description.en:
The name of the IPC device.
You can view the **DeviceName** on the **Devices** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>

description.zh: 加密类型。目前仅支持I帧加密，取值为0。
description.en: The encryption type. Currently, only I-frame encryption is supported. Set the value to 0.

description.zh: 录像结束时间，格式为10位时间戳，单位为秒。
description.en: The recording end time. The value is a 10-digit UNIX timestamp, in seconds.

description.zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)查询。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>
description.en:
The device ID of the IPC device. The ID is issued by IoT Platform to the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device. You can call [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) of IoT Platform to query the device ID.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. **IotId** is a globally unique identifier of a device that corresponds one-to-one to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If the ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no<props="intl"><ph> **Overview** page or</ph></props> ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
播放地址是否可以无限次使用：

- **true**：10秒内可无限次使用。
- **false**（默认）：仅可使用一次。
description.en:
Specifies whether the playback URL can be used an unlimited number of times:

- **true**: can be used an unlimited number of times within 10 seconds.
- **false** (default): can be used only once.

description.zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台**产品**页查看或调用[QueryProductList](~~69271~~)查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
></notice>
description.en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the information about all products under the current account on the **Products** page in the IoT Platform console, or call [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) to query the information.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>

description.zh:
协议类型：
- **rtmp**：RTMP协议。
- **flv**：HTTP-FLV协议。
- **hls**：HLS协议。
 > HLS协议使用限制详细内容，请参见[云端开发](~~208584~~)。
description.en:
The protocol type:
- **rtmp**: RTMP protocol.
- **flv**: HTTP-FLV protocol.
- **hls**: HLS protocol.
 > For the usage limits of the HLS protocol, see [Cloud development](~~208584~~).

description.zh: 相对于录像开始时间**BeginTime**的偏移量，单位为秒，默认值为0。
description.en: The offset from the recording start time **BeginTime**, in seconds. Default value: 0.

description.zh:
是否加密：
- **true**：加密。
- **false**（默认）：不加密。
description.en:
Specifies whether to encrypt the stream:
- **true**: encrypts the stream.
- **false** (default): does not encrypt the stream.

description.zh: URL有效期，取值范围为10~14400，单位为秒。默认值为10。
description.en: The validity period of the URL. Valid values: 10 to 14400. Unit: seconds. Default value: 10.

title.en: Query device live streaming URL by time

descriptions.zh:
## 使用限制

仅支持IPC设备直连物联网平台场景。
descriptions.en:
## Usage notes

Only the scenario in which an IPC device is directly connected to IoT Platform is supported.
